'''evol34 Trainig Luke-Ligth Side''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[evol34]]
* '''Published:''' 6 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif|label=Mind What You Have Learned}}
* '''Strategy:''' Mind What You Have Learned
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PSE MWYHL evol34 LS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

the object of this deck is while training luke you play as many anger fear aggression you have i myself play with 5 but to make 60 cards you can only play with 3

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

After training luke use jedi tests 4 game text to allow you to get out important adding battle destiny look for a weak spot in their defense then attack with everthing the only weakness is when the enemy shuttles to dagaboah the other thing is this deck stops operative force drains the other thing to look out for is broken concentration if he plays with this just throw in at peace and you should be ok.force drain at every chance if you are running low on forse and they play down a 2 power character use noble sacrifice to retreive 9 force. the star ships are for purely defense against shuttling to dagaboah but they can also go and force drain at kessel for three just send them all there with lando and captin han on the falcon i dont think anybody will play a sentinel landing craft against that but also dont get trapped in space this has happened to me before and i have paid by losing a whole battle because all around this deck is pretty fun especially against operative deck's yoyu should see there faces when there 20 force drain becomes a measly 1 and then you force drain for 5.
